svg.text: VCG: pay for the harm you cause
1. Allocate to maximize total value: sum of v_i.
2. Each winner pays the externality: welfare others lose because she participated.
Single item: VCG = second-price auction. Winner pays the second-highest value.
Worked: values 10, 7, 5 -> allocate to bidder 1, she pays 7.
Myerson: for revenue (not welfare), add a reserve price. Optimal auction theory follows.
Source: textbook ch 5.10, original plate. Shell 4: the payment rule.
